source_proof.mode_classes: Stock warm-cache startup reads debug assertions at optimize 0 and strips docstrings at optimize >=2. compileall and py_compile pass optimize=-1 to compile. Raw sys.flags.optimize is retained only in the cache filename; distinct O2 and O3 captures agree in each caller.
source_proof.projection: Only slash-free values are admitted. Intern-membership queries for automatically interned constants and compiler-produced qualified names cannot contain slash; filename identity is modeled separately.
source_proof.retention: Static and immortal entries survive compilation. Every admitted mortal entry has a strong path from an interpreter root, imported module, or suspended caller frame. Enum temporary keys are excluded from presence and absence.
